title: Engineering model management
description: Account for coherent engineering definitions across authoring, interpretation, retention, and contextual retrieval within a selected governed model state.
responsibilities: Compose definition authoring, storage, conformance, and traceability responsibilities so identity, selected-state context, and governing model interpretation retain one coherent meaning across their interactions.
Maintain the architectural boundary between current engineering definitions and the governance decisions or operational records that use them.
Keep definition-access and model-interpretation cooperation explicit within this boundary while preserving the exact child responsible for each behavior, obligation, and information set.

Provide IF-007 as the accountable selected-state content and interpretation contract for Governance Baseline analysis, composing MOD-001 definition access and MOD-003 interpretation without granting authority or claiming retention.

includes: Engineering definition lifecycle, typed model relationships, interpretation, conformance findings, and retrieval of engineering context.
excludes: Baseline/change authority, assurance judgments, published invocation procedures, operational record transaction protocols, and product delivery.
A second owner of child-held model data or a replacement for each child's directly allocated Functions, ARs, and Interfaces.

design_limits: Existing IR-001 and shared SR-012 architecture remains the detailed definition example. IF-007 adds the bounded SCN-019 inspection collaboration; remaining model-management interactions and AR coverage retain their child-owned deferrals.

IF-007 serves MOD-005 across the Governance boundary. Internal IF-001/IF-002 retain their providers and are not exposed wholesale. Retention confirmation, broader Operations access, and other cross-boundary contracts remain to be analyzed.
No direct parent Function, AR, persistent state, or physical realization is introduced. Coherent inspection does not establish a complete retained Baseline or whole-model conformance.

sources.locator: MOD-016; children MOD-001, MOD-002, MOD-003, MOD-004
sources.basis: Proposed parent responsibility derived from the existing child definitions and the user-selected containment structure. The parent owns the stated composition boundary; child definitions, direct allocations, state authority, and contracts retain their identities and meaning. This is draft architecture, not implementation adoption or satisfaction.

sources.locator: MOD-016; SCN-019, SCN-053, SCN-066 selected collaboration analysis
sources.basis: Derive consumer-focused parent contracts for selected-state inspection, adopted-REM authoring guidance, applicable action authority, and evidence applicability. Preserve child behavior/state authority, existing Function/AR allocations, and earlier contract guarantees. The selected contracts refine prior blanket deferrals; remaining retention, wider collaboration, AR, and realization gaps stay explicit. This is draft design analysis, not implemented or satisfied behavior.
